name: Husqvarna 525P5S
blurb: Gas pole saw. 12″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 45 drive links, chain S93G X-Cut, from the 2027 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 525P5S is listed as a professional gas pole saw. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) prints the same row as the 525P4S: 12″ laminate bar 596009745, chain S93G X-Cut 585422145, 3/8″ Mini, .050″ gauge, 45 drive links, 5/32″ file. The 525PT5S on the next line is 44 drive links.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 12″ setup with bar Laminate 596009745 and chain S93G X-Cut 585422145.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover year 2027: certified/approved bar and chain combinations per saw

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover year 2027, 525P5S row, read 7 Nov 2026.
